title: The week Seaty got a skyscraper

lines.text: Okay, so I have to ask. Who looked at our city and thought: you know what this place needs? A black hole.
With bulletproof glass, Leo. Safety first.
Oh, well, then it's totally fine.
Hi everyone, and welcome to the very first Seaty Weekly! I'm Mia.
And I'm Leo. Every weekend we sit down and talk about the city that you, the commenters, are building.
And what a week it was. Leo, give them the numbers.
Eighty seven citizens. One hundred and sixty nine floors. And forty two landmarks, from a hospital to a hot dog stand.
Five days ago this was an empty field. I still can't believe it.
Today we've got the big stories, your funniest comments, some real citizen stories, and... a brand new challenge.
With a prize! Stay until the end.
Biggest story of the week, and I mean biggest. We have a skyscraper!
Black and gold, right on Main Street. Immortal Snail asked for the first skyscraper three times. Three!

card.text: can i have the first skyscraper please

lines.text: And it worked. Persistence pays off in Seaty.
Then there's the black hole reactor. A glass dome, a glowing disk, and a viewing gallery so visitors can watch.
It will never melt down. Or freeze down. That was in the request. I checked.
My personal favourite: Darya asked for a famous university building from Zurich. With the dome!
Right next to a gothic church, inspired by Prague. Downtown is starting to look like a real European city.
And then, out in the green belt... the baguette statue.
A giant girl with red drill pigtails, holding up a baguette like a trophy. Mister Taunty Face said it would be silly.
It is very silly. It's also my new favourite landmark.
Okay, my favourite part. The funniest comments of the week.
Number one. Someone wrote, in capital letters, with fire emojis...

card.text: HOW HAVE YOU NOT YET MADE AN ANTI WATERMELON SEEDS FACTORY?!

lines.text: And we did! The Seedless Watermelon Factory. With a no seeds sign on the roof.
Justice for everyone who ever bit into a seed.
Number two. Railey asked to move in, and said...

card.text: Hey landlord, can i move in i only have 50 cents but, meh

lines.text: Fifty cents! Good news, Railey. Moving to Seaty is free. Keep the fifty cents.
Number three. Gamer Guy asked for twenty large apartments. And a theme park.

card.text: Add 20 large apartments and a theme park

lines.text: One house per citizen, sorry. But the theme park? That one's real.
And number four. Jin asked for a red shrine gate, in all capital letters, and then added...

card.text: GIVE ME MORE LAND FOR THE SHOW AS WELL AS THE HOUSE

lines.text: No extra land, but this week Jin got a whole dojo. And says he's the master now.
Respect the sensei, Leo.
Now, some real citizen stories. Mia, who's at the top of the city right now?
That's Elena. On day one she wrote just three words. Add a mansion!
And the next day: hooray, my mansion is here.
She kept coming back to every video, and now her Grand Mansion has five floors. Number one in Seaty.
Then there's Stay Positive. Honestly, this person built half the city.
A white dome house with a pool. Then a bakery. Then an octopus aquarium. And this week... an elephant in the front yard.
Stay positive, and keep building. Good motto.
And Mark. Mark didn't just ask for a train. He sent us the train model, the line name, everything.

card.text: Im moving in bye Greenville hello seaty

lines.text: Bye Greenville, hello Seaty. Now we have the Seaty Rail Transit, running round the end of Main Street.
That's what I love about this city. Every building has a person behind it.
Okay Mia. Tell them about the challenge.
Starting this week, every week, something is hidden somewhere in Seaty. This week it's a Golden Capybara.

lines.text: And the prize is a golden trophy, standing in front of your house. Forever.
Here's your clue.
Old Town. Behind a cottage with flowers, a little fence, and a smoking chimney.

card.text: Old Town, behind a cottage with flowers, a little fence and a smoking chimney.

lines.text: You have until Friday night. And please, don't post where it is. Just the word.
We'll announce the winner in the daily Short.
Quick visit to City Hall. A lot of new citizens joined this week, so here are the rules.

panel.title: Seaty's rules
items: +1 floor for each different video you comment on

lines.text: One house per citizen. If you ask for a new design, it replaces the old one.

panel.title: Seaty's rules
items: +1 floor for each different video you comment on

lines.text: Floors can't be bought. Every different video you comment on adds one floor.

panel.title: Seaty's rules
items: +1 floor for each different video you comment on

lines.text: You can own two landmarks. And each kind exists only once. One airport, one museum, one skyscraper.

panel.title: Seaty's rules
items: +1 floor for each different video you comment on

lines.text: So if there's something the city doesn't have yet, be quick!
So what's next for Seaty?
Every weekend, a new episode of this show. Every week, a new challenge.
And every single day, a new Short with everyone who moved in and every building we made.
Main Street keeps getting longer, the outskirts keep growing, and your requests decide what comes next.
That's it for episode one. Want to be a citizen too? Just comment on any video.
Find your house on the website, go hunt that Golden Capybara, and we'll see you next weekend!
Bye everyone!
